summary: Migrated yard/quayline.py to Quayline v4 (paths, fields, ends_at/duration conversion, RFC 3339 UTC timestamps, ISO dates, status mapping incl. expired and rescheduled, comma status filter, PATCH cancel instead of the deprecated endpoint, new error body, 201 on create). The existing unit test passes; ApiError.code now carries the v4 code (e.g. slot_conflict, not v3 slot_taken).
